target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: One of Ohio's oldest independent insurance agencies (founded 1828 - nearly 200 years), family-owned with deep roots in Ashtabula. Offers full line of insurance products: homeowners, automobile, business, and life insurance. Independent agency representing multiple carriers. Positioning: 'Big Company Protection, Small Agency Attention' - serving everything from single car risk to multi-state operations. AI policy summarization would help agents efficiently compare complex coverage options across their multiple carrier relationships.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Locally owned independent agency proudly serving Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio for over 80 years. Founded in 1944 (legacy of serving community with dedication and integrity). Family-owned business with highly trained and experienced staff. Offers home, auto, life, and business insurance. 10+ agents who would benefit from AI-powered policy summarization to efficiently analyze and explain complex policy language to customers during the sales process.
